name: skincare-doctor
description: Skincare explainer video with an animated Dr. Skin, built with HyperFrames

scripts.voice: cd video && while IFS=$'\t' read id text; do npx hyperframes tts "$text" -v af_heart -o assets/vo/$id.wav </dev/null; done < ../tools/lines.tsv
scripts.render: cd video && npx hyperframes render -q high -f 30 -o ../../skincare-doctor.mp4
